graph.title: Racer X & Taejo Togokhan (8159)
notes: The two disconnected groups are intentional and are not a defect. Set 8159 is two separate models, each built from its own numbered bag, and the booklet never joins them. Bag 1 is the yellow Racer X car (ids b1-b77, repeat ywheel). Bag 2 is the red Taejo car (ids b100-b181, repeat rwheel). They share no pieces, so I did not add any joined, contact or other edge between the cars. Inside each car every piece is connected.

Page images are small and low-detail, so exact piece sizes, colours and attachment points were inferred. Many LEGO ports are left null. Several joins (e.g. which brick an arch or slope sits on) are best guesses.

Element IDs are not legible in the booklet's parts list. I used catalogue types where a similar piece exists and set the colour as a prop (e.g. lego-346026 for the yellow and dark grey 1x8 plates). Where no catalogue match existed I added new types named by design number or by description.
The steering wheel on plate is lego-3829 (the catalogue's small steering wheel) with a yellow or red colour prop. The red round 1x1 plates (b30, b31) are lego-4211399 with colour=red.

Stickers (yellow set 22-27, red set 1-21) are not modelled as nodes. They are adhesive decals with no LEGO part number, so they are not catalogue parts. They go on the curved slopes, tiles, plates and bumper, and the front stickers are headlights.
The 4 axles (item 8 in the parts list) are 2 per car. Each car's 4 wheels are repeats of rim + tyre + bush.

The yellow car's rear, floor and nose sub-assemblies are connected through the 6x8 black floor plate b21. The red car's sub-assemblies are connected through the red 6x8 plate b120. The booklet shows these joins only as overlapping views.

The inventory counts were not fully reconciled. A few pieces may be omitted or slightly misattributed between the two cars, e.g. 1x1 plates and tiles, and the spare light-grey plates and silver rims on page 31.
